high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from Bloomberg Business's Instagram post, dated 12 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features an interior view of a shopping mall, specifically highlighting the Neiman Marcus store. The setting appears to be a modern, well-lit shopping center with multiple levels and escalators connecting them. People: There are numerous people walking around the mall, some on the ground floor and others on the upper levels. The individuals appear to be shoppers or visitors, casually dressed, suggesting a typical day at the mall.
